section.p: Counterfeit parts have no part in our industry. These parts cause problems from production shutdown to product failure. The best way to receive genuine parts is to purchase them directly through authorised sources.
When you purchase through Mouser Electronics you can be assured that:

ul.li: The products have been obtained directly from the manufacturers or from their authorised channels
The product has been handled and stored in accordance with industry quality standards.
Full access to our manufacturers' full range of up-to-date technical and product information, as well as comprehensive technical support

section.p: We encourage all our customers to establish internal controls to make sure that parts are purchased through authorised distributors.

As a member of ECIA (Electronic Components Industry Association), Mouser Electronics is dedicated to providing factory-warranted, first-quality, genuine components – adhering to the highest standards in customer service.

The mission of ECIA is to promote and improve the business environment for the authorised sale of electronic components. Dedicated to the enhancement of the distributor-manufacturer relationship, this association represents companies involved in the distribution of electronic components and parts, computer and computer peripheral components, and test, measurement, and control equipment and their manufacturers.
